thread.title: This YouTube video shows you have to put the new $2,800 MacBook Pro in a freezer to get it to work properly (AAPL)

author: Antonio Villas-Boas
title: This YouTube video shows you have to put the new $2,800 MacBook Pro in a freezer to get it to work properly (AAPL)
text:
This YouTube video shows you have to put the new $2,800 MacBook Pro in a freezer to get it to work properly Antonio Villas-Boas Jul 19, 2018, 10.54 PM Facebook Linkedin WhatsApp Twitter Google+ Reddit Read full story One YouTuber found he had to put his new 2018 MacBook Pro in a freezer to make it work at its full potential. The MacBook Pro he was using is the brand new 2018 model with the powerful Intel Core i9 processor. If the Core i9 gets too hot, it starts to reduce its own performance to prevent heat damage. The issue here is that Apple's new MacBook Pros can't keep the Core i9 cool enough to perform at even its standard, base performance.
YouTuber Dave Lee of the Dave2D YouTube channel found that the only way he could get the most out of this brand-new 2018 MacBook Pro with a powerful Intel Core i9 processor was to put it in a freezer .
Because of its power, the Core i9 can get extremely hot. When it gets too hot, the processor slows its performance to prevent heat damage to the chip. It's a preventative measure called "thermal throttling."
On its own, and outside the freezer on a desk, the 2018 MacBook Pro with a Core i9 processor couldn't even achieve its base, standard performance because the cooling system inside the laptop can't keep the Core i9 cool enough. It even performed worse than the 2017 MacBook Pro with a less powerful Core i7 chip. Some who bought the 2018 MacBook Pro with a Core i9 processor are cancelling their orders , returning the laptop, or at least thinking about returning or cancelling their orders because of the issue.
Check out Lee's video about the 2018 MacBook Pro with a Core i9 and the huge difference it made before and after he put the laptop in the freezer.
